hook: This dog was locked in a container for eight days.
narration: This dog had been trapped inside a shipping container for at least eight days.
Coast Guard inspectors were on a routine container check in Seabrook, Texas, when they heard barking.
Then scratching, from inside one box.
These checks make sure dangerous cargo is packed and labeled safely before it ships.
outcome: They swung the doors open, and the dog walked out on its own four feet.
title: Dog trapped in a shipping container
description:
Coast Guard marine science technicians from Sector Houston-Galveston found a dog trapped in a shipping container at the Bayport Container Terminal in Seabrook, Texas, on Jan. 31, 2024, after hearing barking and scratching during a routine inspection.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Lucas Loe, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/912242/coast-guard-marine-inspectors-rescue-dog-shipping-container-seabrook-texas
